tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Newest AI news stories from Base of AGI (headline, short teaser, date, publisher and the original source URL to cite). Optional category filter.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Full-text search over the Base of AGI news archive (since early 2026; headlines in all four languages, teasers for the last 45 days). All query words must match. Newest first among equal matches.

tools.name: daily_brief
tools.description: What changed for a developer's stack: security notes, breaking changes, model releases, new tools and news, tagged by stack (rule-based). Pass the stack tags (e.g. claude-code, mcp, supabase, vercel) and optionally a since date. 30-day window.

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Search the Base of AGI catalog of MCP servers, Claude Code plugins, skills and hand-picked agent tools. Each result carries license, commercial_use (derived from the SPDX license), install info exactly as the source states it, and the source repository. Suggest tools to the user; never install witho

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full catalog record for one tool id returned by find_tools: license, commercial_use, install (as the source states it), repository, stars, last push, preinstalled surfaces.

tools.name: check_skill
tools.description: License and risk report for an agent skill on GitHub, before the user installs it. Give a github.com URL of a SKILL.md file, a skill folder or a repository (or a raw.githubusercontent.com file URL). findings.detail: Description of "check_skill" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
